triage_formula: score = 100 x (0.5 people within 10 km [log scale] + 0.3 wind blowing toward a town within 25 km x wind strength + 0.2 growth in the last hour)
notes: Area = fire pixels x GOES-18 pixel size (about 6.4 km2): approximate.
Growth compares the last 15 min with the same 15 min one hour earlier.
Small agricultural or industrial heat sources can appear as 1-pixel incidents.
